how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:seasonal-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8897:obj:0: Deliver Lieutenant Heldric's Carefully Penned Note to Colara Dean outside the bank in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8897:details:0: I've got to keep watch here at the gate, but I'm always worrying about my sweetheart, Colara. I only get to see her for a few hours, if I'm lucky, and well, just look at me. I've got a minor officer's pay and I could be called to the front any day now.
rows.quest:8897:details:1: BWould she just forget about me? There are a lot of men in the city. A lot of rich ones.
rows.quest:8897:details:2: BAnyways, I've scribbled some things down... nothing much, but if you could take it to her for me, that'd be great.
rows.quest:8897:completion:0: Oh, isn't that sweet! This is the first time he's ever sent me something. Do you suppose he's getting serious?
rows.quest:8897:completion:1: BColara Heldric? I suppose it has a ring to it. Oh, but I'm getting ahead of myself. Thank you.
rows.quest:8898:obj:0: Deliver the Creased Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8898:details:0: I met a lass in ⟦E1⟧ when I was last there on the bank's business. She stole my heart away. Now, I can't stop thinking about her! I'd like to send her this message - I've rewritten it twelve times!
rows.quest:8898:details:1: BThe mail is so full now, and I want to make sure it gets there.
rows.quest:8898:details:2: BIf you're heading that way, could you help me?
rows.quest:8898:completion:0: Tormek? Oh yes, I do remember him. He had quite a nice beard and smile underneath.
rows.quest:8898:completion:1: BAh, I can't believe he remembered me!
rows.quest:8899:obj:0: Deliver the Immaculate Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8899:details:0: How to describe her beauty? Thousands of years of words and I am at a loss.
rows.quest:8899:details:1: BThese mortals confound the mind and leave us babbling fools.
rows.quest:8899:details:2: BI've stared at these words too long. No more eloquent meaning can I squeeze from them. No, she must have it now, or some other suitor will surely steal her eye.
rows.quest:8899:completion:0: I've never received something like this before. How lovely!
rows.quest:8900:obj:0: Deliver the Slightly Creased Note to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8900:details:0: She was so sad. I could see that, once I saw past her state. I mean, she seemed sad - wouldn't you?
rows.quest:8900:details:1: BBut after talking to her, there was a connection. I didn't think anyone could understand what I was thinking, but she could.
rows.quest:8900:details:2: BWhen I told the others, they laughed at me, so I never spoke with her again. But I miss her. Can you take this letter to her for me? I want to be sure it finds her hands.
rows.quest:8900:completion:0: You wouldn't expect an orc to be so eloquent. Of course, we never really had a chance to know them before now. Thank you for bringing this to me.
rows.quest:8901:obj:0: Deliver the Carefully Written Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8901:details:0: Have you ever known love, young one? It was a thing foreign to me until lately, when I met a girl from the ⟦E2⟧, Elenia. It is rare enough for one of my kind to look outside our own, let alone one of the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8901:details:1: BBut now thoughts of her occupy my mind both days and nights.
rows.quest:8901:details:2: BIf you can, could you take this letter to her? I want her to come here to ⟦E4⟧. I hope that she will say yes.
rows.quest:8901:completion:0: What kind words Temma writes for me. But, as much as his words move me, I cannot consider the love of a tauren. In thoughts, body and mind we are too different.
rows.quest:8901:completion:1: BIt is good I do not have to receive these thoughts of his in person. I could not bear to break his heart.
rows.quest:8902:obj:0: Deliver the Lovingly Composed Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8902:details:0: A lifetime ago, I was betrothed to marry Elenia, my childhood sweetheart. It's been years since I thought about her last, but of late, she frequently occupies my thoughts.
rows.quest:8902:details:1: BPerhaps, even with everything that has passed, there can be some room in each other's lives for our love.
rows.quest:8902:details:2: BI'm sure she has changed, also. Can you deliver this letter to her for me? I am too nervous to give it in person.
rows.quest:8902:completion:0: This brings back memories from a lifetime ago, ⟦1⟧. Elenia ⟦E5⟧. That was going to be my name, you know. We would have a beautiful ceremony out on the shores of the lake. When he retired, we'd find a farm to retire to.
rows.quest:8902:completion:2: BBut if he saw me now, I doubt he'd even see Elenia in me. Only cold flesh and a dead heart...
rows.quest:8903:obj:0: Get a ⟦E1⟧ Guard's Card and return it to Aristan Mottar in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8903:details:0: There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's not proper, it's an eyesore, and at worst, it could be a threat to the the safety of the ⟦E6⟧ itself.
rows.quest:8903:details:1: BJust think: what if the guards have been taken in by this strange affliction? Something must be done.
rows.quest:8903:details:2: BGo to one of the guards here in ⟦E1⟧ and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
rows.quest:8903:completion:0: So it is true. This is unbelievable. How could this have happened? Let me think for a moment. There must be a reason behind this.
rows.quest:8904:obj:0: Get a Guardian's Moldy Card and bring it to Fenstad Argyle in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8904:details:0: There's something unnatural about this epidemic of love. It's disgusting, and as it lowers our defenses, it could be a threat to the all of us.
rows.quest:8904:details:1: BIt's bad enough that so many of our people are caught up in this ridiculous behavior. But I think that it has spread even to our guardians, who should be immune to such things.
rows.quest:8904:details:2: BFind one of our guardians and see if they've been caught up in this foolishness.
rows.quest:8904:completion:0: So it is true. This is unbelievable. How could this have happened? Let me think for a moment. There must be a reason behind this.
rows.quest:8979:obj:0: Bring 1 Cologne Bottle and 1 Perfume Bottle to Apothecary Zinge in the ⟦E2⟧'s Apothecarium.
rows.quest:8979:details:0: I believe I know the cause of this recent behavior. Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind, over the stink of the canals? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion?
rows.quest:8979:details:1: BOur thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.
rows.quest:8979:details:2: BThere is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to my friend, Apothecary Zinge. The Royal Apothecary Society will find the truth.
rows.quest:8979:details:3: B I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.
rows.quest:8979:completion:0: Another one of Fenstad's obsessions, I see. Does he think that the Royal Apothecary Society has nothing better to do than to perform his little investigations?
rows.quest:8979:completion:1: BVery well, I will humor him once again.
rows.quest:8980:obj:0: Return to Fenstad Argyle outside the bank in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8980:details:0: This is unexpected. It looks like Fenstad might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in mind control potions.
rows.quest:8980:details:1: BIt isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of this, but a few of the ingredients I detected... This is serious alchemy, along the abilities of a member of the Royal Apothecary Society.
rows.quest:8980:completion:0: So, I was right. We must waste no time. We must determine the source of these tainted fragrances.
rows.quest:8980:completion:1: BHere, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.
rows.quest:8982:details:0: We must find who the supplier is. I noticed Apothecary Katrina with a bottle of the perfume tucked in her pack. She told me that she purchased it from Norman, the innkeeper.
rows.quest:8982:completion:0: Ah yes, I just recently received stock of the perfume and cologne. I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves - seems like no one can get enough of it.
rows.quest:8982:completion:1: BIf you ask me, I don't see what the big deal is.
rows.quest:8983:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E8⟧ Rennick at the tailor's shop in the ⟦E2⟧'s Mage Quarter.
rows.quest:8983:details:0: Something's wrong with my product? Well, I've never seen so many people wanting something so badly.
rows.quest:8983:details:1: BI bought my supply from a merchant named ⟦E8⟧ Rennick. She's new in town.
rows.quest:8983:details:2: BShe mentioned she had some goods she had to deliver to the tailor in the Mage Quarter.
rows.quest:8983:completion:0: I'm afraid I sold my entire supply of perfume and cologne to Norman, the innkeeper. If you'd like some, you should speak with him - assuming he has any left.
rows.quest:8983:completion:1: BYou shouldn't waste any time, though. I think you'll find the cologne irresistible.
rows.quest:8984:obj:0: Find Apothecary Staffron Lerent in the ⟦E9⟧ past Ravenholdt Manor.
rows.quest:8984:details:0: Look, the actions of a rogue apothecary are not my concern. If he's undermining our efforts, then let me be the first to point you in the right direction
rows.quest:8984:details:1: BIf he's innocent, then he's got nothing to hide, right?
rows.quest:8984:details:2: BI purchased the goods from Apothecary Staffron Lerent. He's working in a secluded area past Ravenholdt Manor in the hills over Hillsbrad. To be honest with you, I thought he was a little odd.
rows.quest:8984:completion:0: Yes, I made those fragrances. Wonderful smell, isn't it? Irresistible.
rows.quest:8984:completion:1: BOnce the warriors of ⟦E6⟧ and ⟦E10⟧ alike are smitten with these feelings of love, they will be powerless to stop the rise of the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:8984:completion:2: BThey will be weakened, unprepared. As they worry for their loved ones, they will lose their edge.
rows.quest:8984:completion:3: BThe solution was so simple. Why did it take me so long to come upon it? The weakness of all is through the heart. And there is nothing you can do to stop the inevitable.
rows.quest:9024:obj:0: Bring 1 Cologne Bottle and 1 Perfume Bottle to Morgan Pestle in the Trade District of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:9024:details:0: I've got it! Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion? Our guards wouldn't neglect their duties so easily.
rows.quest:9024:details:1: BThat is, unless their thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.
rows.quest:9024:details:2: BThere is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to Morgan Pestle, and tell him my suspicions. I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.
rows.quest:9024:completion:0: I understand Aristan's concerns, but I really think he's overreacting. Let young men and women do what they will. I think Aristan has forgotten what it means to be young and in love.
rows.quest:9024:completion:1: BBut it would be better not to tell him that. We'll humor him.
rows.quest:9025:obj:0: Return to Aristan Mottar outside the bank in ⟦E1⟧'s Trade District.
rows.quest:9025:details:0: Well, I'll be. It looks like Aristan might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in love potions and insidious mind-altering draughts.
rows.quest:9025:details:1: BIt isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of them, but a few of the ingredients I detected... Smells funny.
rows.quest:9025:completion:0: While I thought this would be the case, finding out that my suspicions were correct is still unsettling. We must carefully consider our next move.
rows.quest:9025:completion:1: BHere, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.
rows.quest:9026:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E7⟧ Allison at The Gilded Rose in ⟦E1⟧'s Trade District.
rows.quest:9026:details:0: We've got to find the source. I've seen a lot more people than usual - guards included - going in and out of The Gilded Rose. Talk to Allison. If she's selling them, she can tell you where they came from.
rows.quest:9026:completion:0: Oh yes, I just got the perfume and cologne in stock recently. It's been selling so well, I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves.
rows.quest:9026:completion:1: BIf you ask me, it's kind of boring. Everyone smelling the same? It smells great, but still.
rows.quest:9027:obj:0: Speak with Evert Sorisam at The Finest Thread along ⟦E1⟧'s Canals.
rows.quest:9027:details:0: Something funny about the cologne? It's possible. I've never seen so many people after one product like this.
rows.quest:9027:details:1: BLook, if there's something wrong with it, I want to know, too. I bought my supply from a merchant named Evert Sorisam. He's new in town.
rows.quest:9027:details:2: BHe mentioned he had some goods he was going to deliver to The Finest Thread.
rows.quest:9027:completion:0: Yes, of course. Those fragrances are the hottest items this season. You must be the fifth or sixth person this hour to inquire about them.
rows.quest:9027:completion:1: BI'm afraid my supplies are all sold out. If you'd like some, you should speak with Allison, the innkeeper of The Gilded Rose.
rows.quest:9027:completion:2: BYou shouldn't waste any time, though. I think you'll find the perfume will be irresistible.
rows.quest:9028:obj:0: Find Apothecary Staffron Lerent in the ⟦E9⟧ behind Ravenholdt Manor.
rows.quest:9028:details:0: What? Treason? No, no. I assure you, my intentions are completely harmless.
rows.quest:9028:details:1: BIs it so wrong to help those who wish to ease the painful ritual of courtship? Come, that is no crime.
rows.quest:9028:details:2: BAnd to prove that I mean no harm, I will even tell you my source.
rows.quest:9028:details:3: BThey were shipped to me by a Staffron Lerent, an apothecary of some sort. I never spoke with him.
rows.quest:9028:details:4: BOur goblin middle man said that he worked in the foothills over Hillsbrad past that mysterious Ravenholdt Manor. I wish you luck in finding him.
rows.quest:9028:completion:0: Yes, I made those fragrances. Wonderful smell, isn't it? Irresistible.
rows.quest:9028:completion:1: BOnce the warriors of ⟦E6⟧ and ⟦E10⟧ alike are smitten with these feelings of love, they will be powerless to stop the rise of the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:9028:completion:2: BThey will be weakened, unprepared. As they worry for their loved ones, they will lose their edge.
rows.quest:9028:completion:3: BThe solution was so simple. Why did it take me so long to come upon it? The weakness of all is through the heart. And there is nothing you can do to stop the inevitable.
rows.quest:9029:completion:0: A pleasant smell wafts up from the cauldron.
